title: Simai Background Effect Manifest v1
description: An animated background drawn into one area of a page. A product reads only this file to list, describe and configure an effect, without running its code.

schema.description: The format: simai.effect with schema_version 1. The older label simai.effect.v1 is read until the change journal retires it (names carry no version, 2026-10-11).

schemes.description: The themes the effect is drawn for (simai.effect 1.1). The first is its home scheme: the default and the one its preview shows. Absent means both, as in 1.0. The host gives the effect the scheme it draws in as context.scheme, and a change of it through update(settings, context).

pair.description: The effect of the other scheme that plays the same role (simai.effect 1.1): the id of an effect in the same catalogue, or the https URL of another effect's effect.json. Only a single-scheme effect names one, and the pair must draw the scheme this one lacks. A pair is resolved and loaded under the same trust as any effect: an id resolves against the catalogue base and is checked against that catalogue index's SHA-256 before it runs inline; a URL outside the pinned catalogue is foreign and runs only in the sandbox runner, refused until one is available; a trusted effect never pulls an untrusted pair inline.

capabilities.description: What the effect is safe to be drawn for beyond one area (simai.effect 1.1). windows: it is mask-safe, so one scene may be drawn behind a group of cards and seen only through them, continuous across them.

max.description: The upper bound of a number, or the longest a string or text may be.

accept.description: For a file: the kinds of the site's files that may be chosen.
